rejected_environment_options.reason: Attempt 7 produced an observable isolation abort after prior-package breadcrumbs were surfaced.
This conversation already contains extensive target qualification history, prior cases, remediation state, and protected-generation history.
Regular personalized context does not establish the required observable separation from prior Hetren work.
Project context is specifically useful for continuity and therefore inappropriate for blind generation.
Custom GPT instructions, knowledge, or configuration would add unnecessary generation-environment variables.

interpretation: Attempt 8 will use an explicitly Unpersonalized Temporary ChatGPT conversation as an observable application-level sequestered generation boundary. The same user account is permitted because the relevant product controls disable memory, custom instructions, and plugins for that temporary conversation. Automatic Library search is separately disabled, the chat is started outside any project, only Package v8 is uploaded from local disk, and no web/external retrieval is permitted. The decision does not claim absolute provider statelessness. A separate pre-generation environment attestation is required before the frozen package is supplied.
